pages.name: Sakila - Film Rental Analytics
pages.description: Rental trends, monthly revenue, customer geography, and film category distribution from Sakila (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB).

cards.title: Revenue by month (Sakila, MySQL)
cards.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(p.payment_date, '%Y-%m') AS `Month`, SUM(p.amount) AS `Revenue` FROM payment p GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(p.payment_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY `Month`

cards.title: Top 10 films by rental count (Sakila, MariaDB)
cards.sql: SELECT f.title AS `Film`, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS `Rentals` FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title ORDER BY `Rentals` DESC LIMIT 10

cards.title: Customers by country (Sakila, PostgreSQL)
cards.sql: SELECT co.country AS "Country", COUNT(c.customer_id) AS "Customers" FROM customer c JOIN address a ON a.address_id = c.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id GROUP BY co.country_id, co.country ORDER BY "Customers" DESC LIMIT 10

cards.title: Film count by category (Sakila, PostgreSQL)
cards.sql: SELECT c.name AS "Category", COUNT(fc.film_id) AS "Films" FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY "Films" DESC

cards.title: Top 10 customers by spending (Sakila, MySQL)
cards.sql: SELECT CONCAT(c.first_name, ' ', c.last_name) AS `Customer`, SUM(p.amount) AS `Total Spent` FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY `Total Spent` DESC LIMIT 10

pages.name: Chinook - Music & Media Store
pages.description: Artist catalog, track metrics, genre breakdowns, and invoice sales by country from Chinook (PostgreSQL, SQL Server).

cards.title: Top 10 artists by track count (Chinook, PostgreSQL)
cards.sql: SELECT ar.name AS "Artist", COUNT(t.track_id) AS "Tracks" FROM artist ar JOIN album al ON al.artist_id = ar.artist_id JOIN track t ON t.album_id = al.album_id GROUP BY ar.artist_id, ar.name ORDER BY "Tracks" DESC LIMIT 10

cards.title: Tracks by genre (Chinook, PostgreSQL)
cards.sql: SELECT g.name AS "Genre", COUNT(t.track_id) AS "Tracks" FROM genre g JOIN track t ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id GROUP BY g.genre_id, g.name ORDER BY "Tracks" DESC

cards.title: Sales by billing country (Chinook, PostgreSQL)
cards.sql: SELECT billing_country AS "Country", ROUND(SUM(total)::numeric, 2) AS "Sales" FROM invoice GROUP BY billing_country ORDER BY "Sales" DESC LIMIT 10

cards.title: Top 10 longest tracks (Chinook, PostgreSQL)
cards.sql: SELECT t.name AS "Track", ROUND(t.milliseconds / 60000.0, 1) AS "Minutes" FROM track t ORDER BY t.milliseconds DESC LIMIT 10

cards.title: Albums per artist (Chinook, SQL Server)
cards.sql: SELECT TOP 10 ar.Name AS "Artist", COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS "Albums" FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY "Albums" DESC

pages.name: Cross-Engine Benchmarks & Inventory
pages.description: Operational insights and distribution metrics across PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, and SQL Server.

cards.title: Film inventory count by store (Sakila, MariaDB)
cards.sql: SELECT store_id AS `Store`, COUNT(inventory_id) AS `Inventory Items` FROM inventory GROUP BY store_id

cards.title: Film ratings breakdown (Sakila, MySQL)
cards.sql: SELECT rating AS `Rating`, COUNT(film_id) AS `Films` FROM film GROUP BY rating ORDER BY `Films` DESC

cards.title: Media types distribution (Chinook, PostgreSQL)
cards.sql: SELECT mt.name AS "Media Type", COUNT(t.track_id) AS "Tracks" FROM media_type mt JOIN track t ON t.media_type_id = mt.media_type_id GROUP BY mt.media_type_id, mt.name ORDER BY "Tracks" DESC

cards.title: Customer invoice count (Chinook, SQL Server)
cards.sql: SELECT TOP 10 c.FirstName + ' ' + c.LastName AS "Customer", COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS "Invoices" FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY "Invoices" DESC
